g.text: ≤5 items per bucket · one bucket each
ROUTE · exactly one route runs per plan · a branch, not a fan

text.tspan: one valid group at a time

svg.text: parallel-specialists route only · parent-owned commands in order

g.text: FAN 2–4 · CHILD WORKTREES · one detached worktree per bucket, dispatched as one wave
JOIN · all terminal handovers · parent re-derives each patch from its worktree
Apply the integrated bundle to the repository
REJOIN · selected fixes applied in source, whichever route ran
full suite once · repo settings · docs-only: skipped
format hook clean before inputs freeze
later change → refresh inputs, rerun bundle
no fan · one bucket at a time
one bounded pass · not a fan
one coherent bucket → parent-owned, no worktree
dependent work or no capacity → reason recorded, no prompt
child postimage check fails → blocks handover and integration
unrelated dirty paths → kept unstaged, not a blocker
+report → no new review · +review → review step first
